lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: A monk and a warrior. People keep expecting us to argue.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: We pursue the same end by different roads. No conflict.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: You train even when you don't need to.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: If I wait until I need to, I'm already behind.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: Your order — do they take oaths?

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: One. No oath can be broken that was honestly meant when it was sworn.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: That's more honest than most codes I've sworn to.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: You stopped yourself from striking just then.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: You're probably the calmest person I've traveled with.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: The surface is calm. The interior argues constantly.

lines.speaker: orren_gravetide
lines.text: You just don't let it out.
